article.title: Procedure if application admitted.
article.content: Where the application is granted, it shall be numbered and registered, and shall be deemed the plaint in the suit, and the suit shall proceed in all other respects as a suit instituted in the ordinary manner, except that the plaintiff shall not be liable to pay any court-fee 2[or fees payable for service of process] in respect of any petition, appointment of a pleader or other proceeding connected with the suit.
article.html:
8Procedure if application admitted.

Order 33, Rule 8

Where the application is granted, it shall be numbered and registered, and shall be deemed the plaint in the suit, and the suit shall proceed in all other respects as a suit instituted in the ordinary manner, except that the plaintiff shall not be liable to pay any court-fee 2[or fees payable for service of process] in respect of any petition, appointment of a pleader or other proceeding connected with the suit.

2 Subs. by s. 81, ibid., for “other than fees pay able for service of process” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
